description:
Outcome-first view of model token consumption, input-cache efficiency, conversations, reliability, and operational breakdowns.
How each is measured can be different at both provider and harness level, the data tries to normalise where possible, but check info icon for validity - use to identify operational issues rather than benchmark cross performance.
title: All Model Usage

cc4a7e66-1fad-49e1-920c-c79c8b3cb673.description: Filter model-usage panels by Codex, Claude Code, or Oh My Pi telemetry service.
cc4a7e66-1fad-49e1-920c-c79c8b3cb673.name: service_name

widgets.description: Normalized total model input: Codex input plus Claude Code and Oh My Pi direct, cache-created, and cache-read input.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
WITH usage_events AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS timestamp_nano, resource.`service.name`::String AS harness, attributes_string['conversation.id'] AS native_session_id, 'OpenAI' AS provider, attributes_string['model'] AS model,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'input_token_count'),attributes_number['input_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['input_token_count'])) AS input_tokens,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'cached_token_count'),attributes_number['cached_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['cached_token_count'])) AS cached_input,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'output_token_count'),attributes_number['output_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['output_token_count'])) AS output_tokens, toUInt64(1) AS completed_operations
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND resource.`service.name`::String IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs')
    AND attributes_string['event.name']='codex.sse_event' AND attributes_string['conversation.id']!='' AND attributes_string['model']!='' AND (mapContains(attributes_number,'input_token_count') OR mapContains(attributes_string,'input_token_count'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp AS timestamp_nano, 'claude-code' AS harness, attributes_string['session.id'] AS native_session_id, 'Anthropic' AS provider, attributes_string['model'] AS model,
    attributes_number['input_tokens']+attributes_number['cache_creation_tokens']+attributes_number['cache_read_tokens'] AS input_tokens, attributes_number['cache_read_tokens'] AS cached_input, attributes_number['output_tokens'] AS output_tokens, toUInt64(1) AS completed_operations
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String='claude-code'
    AND attributes_string['event.name']='api_request' AND attributes_string['session.id']!='' AND attributes_string['model']!=''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS timestamp_nano, 'oh-my-pi' AS harness, attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id'] AS native_session_id,
    multiIf(lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%anthropic%','Anthropic',lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%openai%','OpenAI',attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) AS provider, attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model,
    attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'] AS input_tokens,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'),attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'],0) AS cached_input, attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'] AS output_tokens, toUInt64(1) AS completed_operations
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi'
    AND attributes_string['gen_ai.operation.name']='chat' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id']!='' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model']!='' AND mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens')
    AND (attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']>0 OR attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']>0)
)
SELECT sum(input_tokens) AS `Input tokens` FROM usage_events

)

UNION ALL

UNION ALL

WITH usage_events AS (

widgets.title: Usage-Active Sessions Over Time

widgets.description: Operational outcomes use producer-native boundaries. Codex response attempts are app-server-only when present, attempt-level, and exclude catalog refreshes; Claude Code counts terminal LLM requests; Oh My Pi counts terminal chat operations. Treat each harness as its own health trend.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
WITH native_outcomes AS (
  SELECT 'OpenAI' AS provider, resource.`service.name`::String AS harness, 'Codex response attempt' AS measurement,
    if(mapContains(attributes_bool,'success'),attributes_bool['success'],NOT (mapContains(attributes_string,'error.message') AND attributes_string['error.message']!='')) AS succeeded
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND resource.`service.name`::String IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs')
    AND attributes_string['event.name']='codex.api_request' AND attributes_string['endpoint']='/responses' AND attributes_string['conversation.id']!='' AND attributes_string['model']!=''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Anthropic','claude-code','Claude logical request',NOT (has_error OR status_code_string='Error') FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND serviceName='claude-code' AND name='claude_code.llm_request'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT multiIf(lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%anthropic%','Anthropic',lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%openai%','OpenAI',attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']),'oh-my-pi','OMP logical chat',NOT (has_error OR status_code_string='Error') FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.operation.name']='chat'
)
SELECT provider AS `Provider`, harness AS `Harness`, measurement AS `Measurement`, countIf(succeeded) AS `Success`, countIf(NOT succeeded) AS `Failure`, round(100*countIf(NOT succeeded)/count(),1) AS `Failure rate` FROM native_outcomes GROUP BY provider,harness,measurement ORDER BY `Failure rate` DESC,`Failure` DESC,provider,harness

widgets.description: Failure rate is failed native operations divided by all native operations in each time bucket. Codex response attempts exclude catalog refreshes and are attempt-level; Claude Code counts terminal LLM requests; Oh My Pi counts terminal chat operations. Compare each harness with its own history.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: WITH greatest(toUInt32(1),toUInt32(($end_timestamp_nano-$start_timestamp_nano)/1000000000/120)) AS bucket_seconds, native_outcomes AS (SELECT timestamp AS timestamp_nano, multiIf(resource.`service.name`::String='codex-app-server','Codex App',resource.`service.name`::String='codex_exec','Codex Exec','Codex CLI') AS series, NOT if(mapContains(attributes_bool,'success'),attributes_bool['success'],NOT (mapContains(attributes_string,'error.message') AND attributes_string['error.message']!='')) AS failed FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND resource.`service.name`::String IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs') AND attributes_string['event.name']='codex.api_request' AND attributes_string['endpoint']='/responses' AND attributes_string['conversation.id']!='' AND attributes_string['model']!='' UNION ALL SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)),'Claude Code',has_error OR status_code_string='Error' FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND serviceName='claude-code' AND name='claude_code.llm_request' UNION ALL SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)),'OMP',has_error OR status_code_string='Error' FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.operation.name']='chat') SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp_nano),toIntervalSecond(bucket_seconds)) AS timestamp, series, 100*countIf(failed)/nullIf(count(),0) AS value FROM native_outcomes GROUP BY timestamp,series ORDER BY timestamp,series

widgets.title: Native Operation Failure Rate Over Time

widgets.description: P95 uses each producer’s native operation duration. Codex sampling turns include retry handling, response processing, and in-flight tool draining; Claude Code LLM requests and Oh My Pi chat spans cover terminal logical provider calls. Compare each series with its own history; absolute values are not cross-harness performance benchmarks.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
WITH
  greatest(toUInt32(1),toUInt32(($end_timestamp_nano-$start_timestamp_nano)/1000000000/120)) AS bucket_seconds,
  native_durations AS (
    SELECT
      toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS timestamp_nano,
      'OpenAI' AS provider,
      serviceName AS harness,
      'Codex sampling turn' AS measurement,
      duration_nano/1000000000 AS duration_seconds
    FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
    WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano)
      AND serviceName IN $service_name
      AND serviceName IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs')
      AND name='run_sampling_request'
      AND attributes_string['model']!=''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS timestamp_nano,
      'Anthropic' AS provider,
      'claude-code' AS harness,
      'Claude logical request' AS measurement,
      duration_nano/1000000000 AS duration_seconds
    FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
    WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano)
      AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name
      AND serviceName='claude-code'
      AND name='claude_code.llm_request'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS timestamp_nano,
      multiIf(lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%anthropic%','Anthropic',lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%openai%','OpenAI',attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) AS provider,
      'oh-my-pi' AS harness,
      'OMP logical chat' AS measurement,
      duration_nano/1000000000 AS duration_seconds
    FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
    WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano)
      AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name
      AND serviceName='oh-my-pi'
      AND attributes_string['gen_ai.operation.name']='chat'
      AND attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model']!=''
  )
SELECT
  toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp_nano),toIntervalSecond(bucket_seconds)) AS timestamp,
  multiIf(harness='codex-app-server','Codex App',harness='codex_exec','Codex Exec',harness='codex_cli_rs','Codex CLI',harness='claude-code','Claude Code',harness='oh-my-pi','OMP',harness) AS series,
  quantileExact(0.95)(duration_seconds) AS value
FROM native_durations
GROUP BY timestamp,series
ORDER BY timestamp,series

widgets.description: Per-session model usage and cache efficiency across selected harnesses.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
WITH usage_events AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS timestamp_nano, resource.`service.name`::String AS harness, attributes_string['conversation.id'] AS native_session_id, 'OpenAI' AS provider, attributes_string['model'] AS model,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'input_token_count'),attributes_number['input_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['input_token_count'])) AS input_tokens,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'cached_token_count'),attributes_number['cached_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['cached_token_count'])) AS cached_input,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'output_token_count'),attributes_number['output_token_count'],toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['output_token_count'])) AS output_tokens, toUInt64(1) AS completed_operations
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND resource.`service.name`::String IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String IN ('codex-app-server','codex_exec','codex_cli_rs')
    AND attributes_string['event.name']='codex.sse_event' AND attributes_string['conversation.id']!='' AND attributes_string['model']!='' AND (mapContains(attributes_number,'input_token_count') OR mapContains(attributes_string,'input_token_count'))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp AS timestamp_nano, 'claude-code' AS harness, attributes_string['session.id'] AS native_session_id, 'Anthropic' AS provider, attributes_string['model'] AS model,
    attributes_number['input_tokens']+attributes_number['cache_creation_tokens']+attributes_number['cache_read_tokens'] AS input_tokens, attributes_number['cache_read_tokens'] AS cached_input, attributes_number['output_tokens'] AS output_tokens, toUInt64(1) AS completed_operations
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN $start_timestamp_nano AND $end_timestamp_nano AND 'claude-code' IN $service_name AND resource.`service.name`::String='claude-code'
    AND attributes_string['event.name']='api_request' AND attributes_string['session.id']!='' AND attributes_string['model']!=''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS timestamp_nano, 'oh-my-pi' AS harness, attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id'] AS native_session_id,
    multiIf(lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%anthropic%','Anthropic',lower(attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) LIKE '%openai%','OpenAI',attributes_string['gen_ai.provider.name']) AS provider, attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model'] AS model,
    attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'] AS input_tokens,
    if(mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'),attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'],0) AS cached_input, attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'] AS output_tokens, toUInt64(1) AS completed_operations
  FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($start_timestamp_nano) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano($end_timestamp_nano) AND 'oh-my-pi' IN $service_name AND serviceName='oh-my-pi'
    AND attributes_string['gen_ai.operation.name']='chat' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.conversation.id']!='' AND attributes_string['gen_ai.request.model']!='' AND mapContains(attributes_number,'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens')
    AND (attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']>0 OR attributes_number['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']>0)
)
SELECT native_session_id AS `Session`, harness AS `Harness`, provider AS `Provider`, model AS `Model`, sum(input_tokens) AS `Input tokens`, sum(cached_input) AS `Cached input`, sum(output_tokens) AS `Output tokens`, sum(completed_operations) AS `Completed model calls`, sum(input_tokens)-sum(cached_input) AS `Uncached input`, round(100*sum(cached_input)/nullIf(sum(input_tokens),0),1) AS `Cache utilization` FROM usage_events GROUP BY harness,native_session_id,provider,model ORDER BY `Input tokens` DESC LIMIT 5000
